description: Record a building expense (הוצאה). A second call records another expense.

amount.description: Expense amount, in the building currency.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

cashBoxAmount.description: Part of the expense paid from the building cash box.

category.description: Expense category, e.g. Cleaning, Elevator, Repairs.

name: create_expense
title: Record expense
